description_en: Queries the details of O&M tasks
kebab_example: aliyun dds describe-active-operation-task --biz-region cn-shanghai --task-type rds_apsaradb_ha --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeActiveOperationTask

parameters.help_en: The ID of the region to which the pending events belong. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/61933.html operation to query region IDs. If you set this parameter to all, all tasks under the current account are queried, and the TaskType parameter must also be set to all
parameters.help_zh: 待处理事件所属的地域 ID，可通过https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/61933.html查询。all代表查询该用户下所有的任务，此参数为all， taskType也必须为all
parameters.name: region

parameters.help_en:
The task type. Valid values:

rds_apsaradb_ha: primary/secondary node switch.
rds_apsaradb_transfer: instance migration.
rds_apsaradb_upgrade: minor version update.

You can obtain the valid values from the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2639186.html operation.

If you set this parameter to all, all tasks under the current account are queried, and the Region parameter must also be set to all
parameters.help_zh:
任务类型，取值：

rds_apsaradb_ha：主从节点切换。
rds_apsaradb_transfer：实例迁移。
rds_apsaradb_upgrade：小版本升级。

取值来源https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2639186.html。

传入all代表查询该用户下所有的任务，此参数为all时， region也必须为all
parameters.name: task_type

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to return historical tasks. Valid values:

0: returns current tasks. This is the default value.
1: returns historical tasks
parameters.help_zh:
是否返回历史任务，取值：

0：默认值，返回当前任务。
1：返回历史任务
parameters.name: is_history

parameters.help_en: The maximum number of entries to return on each page. The value must be greater than 10. Default value: 30
parameters.help_zh: 每页可展示的最大记录数，取值需大于 10，默认值为 30
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en: The page number. The value must be greater than 0 and not exceed the maximum value of the Integer data type. Default value: 1
parameters.help_zh: 页码，大于 0 且不超过 Integer 数据类型的最大值，默认值为 1
parameters.name: page_number

CreatedTime.description_en: The time when the O&M task was created. The format is `yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ` (UTC time)
CreatedTime.description_zh: 运维任务创建时间，格式为`yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ`（UTC 时间）

Deadline.description_en: The latest time within the adjustable range for the execution time of the O&M task. The format is `yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ` (UTC time)
Deadline.description_zh: 运维任务执行时间可调整范围的最晚期时间，格式为`yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ`（UTC 时间）

ModifiedTime.description_en: The time when the O&M task was modified. The format is `yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ` (UTC time)
ModifiedTime.description_zh: 运维任务修改时间，格式为`yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ`（UTC 时间）

PrepareInterval.description_en: The preparation time required between the start time and the switchover time of the O&M task. The format is HH:mm:ss
PrepareInterval.description_zh: 运维任务开始时间到切换时间之间所需的准备时间，格式为HH:mm:ss

StartTime.description_en: The execution time of the O&M task. The format is `yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ` (UTC time)
StartTime.description_zh: 运维任务执行的时间，格式为`yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ`（UTC 时间）

Status.description_en:
The task status. Valid values:
2: Waiting for the user to specify a time.
3: Waiting to be processed.
4: Processing. After the task enters this state, the scheduled switchover time cannot be modified.
5: Succeeded.
6: Failed.
7: Canceled
Status.description_zh:
任务状态，返回值：
2：等待用户指定时间。
3：等待处理。
4：处理中。进入此状态后，不可修改计划切换时间。
5：成功。
6：失败。
7：已取消

SwitchTime.description_en: The switchover time of the O&M task. The format is `yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ` (UTC time)
SwitchTime.description_zh: 运维任务切换时间，格式为`yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ`（UTC 时间）

TaskType.description_en:
The task type. Valid values:

rds_apsaradb_ha: primary/secondary node switch.
rds_apsaradb_transfer: instance migration.
rds_apsaradb_upgrade: minor version update
TaskType.description_zh:
任务类型，返回值：

rds_apsaradb_ha：主从节点切换。
rds_apsaradb_transfer：实例迁移。
rds_apsaradb_upgrade：小版本升级

PageSize.description_en: The number of entries returned per page. Default value: 30
